entries.title: Artificial Analysis: Gemini 4 Neon trails only Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra on the Intelligence Index and rivals Opus 5.5 on coding at a much lower cost (Artificial Analysis)
How Alibaba uses regional companies like Megaspeed to access Nvidia chips via offshore data centers and potentially aid a Chinese military-linked AI lab (New York Times)
Hackers compromised Microsoft's Agent Framework Python package on PyPI, publishing two versions designed to steal cloud credentials and other information (Bill Toulas/BleepingComputer)
The US DOJ indicts a Russian national for allegedly working for Moscow to stalk staff of a tech and defense firm aiding Ukraine, which a source says is Palantir (Bloomberg)
OpenAI says agents now complete 46% of its researchers' 2-to-4-hour tasks on their own, vs. 23% in March, median researcher's agent use hit $2,400/day, and more (OpenAI)
Source: MoviePass is exploring a sale, pitching potential buyers on bundling movie tickets with streaming subscriptions; it has $10M in annual recurring revenue (Mark Stenberg/Adweek)
NYC, LA, and Chicago school districts are weighing alternatives to Google Search after Google declined to offer schools a version of Search without AI features (New York Times)
Filing: Anthropic raised ~$3B from Japanese investors as part of its IPO, the lower end of its planned range of $3B to $3.5B (Yasutaka Tamura/Bloomberg)
At DealBook, Elon Musk says he feels "pretty foolish" after spending nearly $500M backing Republicans in midterms won by Democrats and claims "I'm not MAGA" (Todd Spangler/Variety)
Gemini 4 Neon costs $3/1M input tokens and $15/1M output tokens; the model sits between Hydrogen and Carbon and replaces Argon in the Gemini app (Abner Li/9to5Google)
The Homeland Security Task Force launches the Threat Disruption Center to fight crypto fraud and cybercrime, using TRM Labs' AI platform via a ~$95M no-bid deal (Bloomberg)
Palo Alto Networks reports Q1 revenue up 39% YoY to $3.45B, above $3.31B est., and raises its FY 2027 revenue forecast; PANW jumps 7%+ after hours (Reuters)
Sources: Leopold Aschenbrenner discussed "Situational Awareness 2.0", a reboot using leverage and outside capital, four months after Citadel rescued his fund (Financial Times)
OpenAI says its models improved power, performance, and area by up to 14% on AMD's flagship GPU IP; some changes are in a design AMD sent for manufacturing (OpenAI)
Google rolls out Gemini 4 Neon, with "fast end-to-end task completion" across coding, knowledge work, and science, in the API, Antigravity, and the Gemini app (Koray Kavukcuoglu/Google)
